mapper.insert: insert into goodfish_item_prompt (item_id, system_prompt, price_prompt, tech_prompt, default_prompt, max_reply_length) values (#{itemId}, #{systemPrompt}, #{pricePrompt}, #{techPrompt}, #{defaultPrompt}, #{maxReplyLength}) on conflict (item_id) do update set system_prompt = excluded.system_prompt, price_prompt = excluded.price_prompt, tech_prompt = excluded.tech_prompt, default_prompt = excluded.default_prompt, max_reply_length = excluded.max_reply_length, update_time = now()
